# Global Conflicts Workbench

Standalone, metadata-only **authoring/download collection prototype**. It is
not a gameplay requirement and must never be included in mission server lists.
It has no scripts, prefabs, editor-control code or MCP dependency.

The development identity `6B8E05204D634FA9` is experimental, not a published
Workshop registration. The dependency snapshot was generated on 2026-11-15
from the local GC Core, Units, Missions and Lobby Dev projects. Server Admin
Tools, Scenario Reload Menu, Bacon Loadout Editor and Everything Arsenal were
subsequently removed from both Core Dev and this collection. There are 102
direct entries including the base game. Keep this addon outside GC Lobby Workshop releases.

See `../../source/mission-launcher/README.md` for generation, tests, limitations,
and the required migration of optional content out of Core's dependency closure.
